entities.summary: Anne Oterholm is an American-born Norwegian novelist and literary critic. Among her novels are Ikke noe annet enn det du vil from 1995 and Avbrutt selskap from 1996. From 2005 to 2012 she was the leader of the Norwegian Authors' Union. She was awarded the Aschehoug Prize in 2010.
